scope: 2nd edition base/core 2–4 players, standard 16-round game; Universal Rules Compendium 2025-12-17 + Corrigendum 1.0 2026-10-06; no expansions/options

questions.question: How many ordinary turns does each player take in the standard 16-round game, and what happens (including service rotation and ongoing tile benefits) on a courtship round?
State the ordered procedure for hosting an activity, including when round-track events and ongoing effects happen and where used servants, gentry and the tile go at cleanup.

When passing, in what order do you recover servants and gentry, resolve events/ongoing effects, take a passing benefit and buy? What benefits are available in this base-only scope, and may you hire through Butler’s Room as a passing benefit?

Your reputation is 6.1 after step 2 and you plan a PR6 activity with PR6 guests, but need four Service Help actions that lower your actual reputation to 3.4. Is this legal, which servants can Service Help refresh, and what reputation is used to screen the tile and guests?
How must positive and negative favours be ordered? At minimum reputation can you take a negative reputation favour first to avoid the loss, and what is required to play a guest with a money penalty?
Give all three special action costs, their per-turn limits and the minimum-reputation restriction. Can service help take a servant straight out of Expended Service?
How do you hire with the base Butler’s Room activity, may any gentry attend, where do new hires go, and how does upgrading change the recruiting option?
When may a housekeeper substitute for a lady’s maid, when may a footman substitute for a valet, and can an underbutler substitute while the regular male servant is still available?
How can an underbutler be acquired in the base game, when is it available, and can another player recruit it?
How is a tile’s purchase price calculated in the Market and Reserve, what is the minimum price, and can you buy a tile you already own or one above your reputation?

When refilling the Market after a purchase, what happens to remaining tiles, a drawn duplicate, a reserve-eligible tile and multiple newly drawn tiles? Does buying just one tile from a duplicate stack cause a refill?
After seasons 1 and 2, which Market tiles move to Reserve, what exception applies, what happens to later draws, and is a full seasonal Market refresh standard here?
For an ordinary (nonfinal) courtship, how are Fairchilds returned, theme scores and ties handled, and objectives discarded? Which direction does the first-player marker then pass?
How does final courtship differ in scoring and tie resolution, and what last actions are permitted before end-game scoring?
List all end-game VP categories, the points for reputation levels 1–7, wealth rounding, and the complete victory tiebreak sequence.
How many objectives do you normally receive and retain for scoring in a standard game, what happens to simultaneous discards, and must tile objectives show upgraded tiles?
When can VP cards be used for benefits, where do used cards go, and what happens to retained cards at game end?

Explain the mandatory flip rules for a normal activity tile, an already-upgraded tile, a hybrid, and a tile that upgrades into an ongoing monument. Which category counts for a hybrid at courtship and for objectives?
When do monuments and Servants’ Hall work on a hosting turn and a pass turn? How does Servants’ Hall use a servant, and may it target a player at minimum reputation?
Compare Heritage Guest Suite, Queen’s Suite and Lionheart Suite: which guest is used, service and doubling rules, subsequent tile state, and whether their single-guest count can be changed.
How is the first player chosen, in what order do players choose families, and what are the four base family bonuses?
What reputation counters, starting reputation, five servants, five tiles and ordinary family cards does each player receive, and which families start with money?
After distributing starting servants, how many of each type are placed in Servants for Hire for three players, what types are absent, and can unused boxed servants be hired later?
How are the two initial guests selected, and what happens to all starter guests not dealt to players? Are starter guests a separate guest type during play?

How many double-sided monuments go into the bag for four players, can both Estate monuments be selected, and do tiles that later upgrade into monuments count against the selection or stay out of the bag?

Describe the opening Builders’ Market eligibility, number of different spaces, handling of ineligible and duplicate draws, orientation and sorting. May PR4 tiles, Servants’ Hall or a double-sided monument enter it?
Describe setup of Alderley Hall, reminder tokens, Fairchild cards, theme and VP decks. Is the first theme hidden, and do old revealed themes leave play when a new one is revealed?
A servant begins your hosting turn in Expended Service and another in Servants’ Quarters. Where does each go during rotation, and what happens to an available servant you never use that turn?

On a Village Fair turn your Private Study is not upgraded. Can you host its activity later that turn and collect the Fair reward immediately? What reward would an already-upgraded Study give, and on which standard spaces?
At the standard Draw Objectives event, when is it resolved, how many cards are drawn and kept, and do passing players receive it?
During National Holiday, may low-reputation players play higher-PR tiles and guests? Which other requirements remain binding?

During Builders’ Holiday, can you buy several tiles at their original prices, slide/refill after each purchase, or refresh between purchases? Can the Reserve be included, and how does Market Purchase VP-card use relate?
A full Market refresh is triggered. Where do removed Market tiles go while replacements are drawn, when do they return to the bag, and what happens to Reserve tiles?
Explain reputation increments crossing level boundaries, the standard minimum and maximum, treatment of losses beyond minimum, and how to avoid wasting reputation from a large favour at maximum.
Is money held secret, can players give each other money in standard multiplayer, can money costs exceed your holdings, and what if the common supply runs out?

An activity asks for two ladies or for two casual guests. Can family members fill each kind of requirement, may extra gentry be played, and do family members require personal servants or a reputation threshold?
For an ordinary guest invite and a screening invite, what cards must be revealed, what is added to hand, and where do rejected screened cards go?

A dismissal favour is available but you have no unwanted guests. Must you dismiss, can you dismiss a guest just drawn earlier in Enjoy Favours or from the current activity, can family be dismissed, and what happens to ownership and later scoring?
State the favours of the ordinary Lord, Lady, Heir and Asquith Dowager. Which offer a choice and which give both benefits?

The Young Lady attends with a male casual guest, a female prestige guest, or Charles Fairchild. In which cases does she gain the admirer bonus, what is that bonus, and does she still draw a casual guest?
Give base Charles and Elizabeth Fairchild’s personal service, favours, guest type and PR restrictions. Do these cards behave as family cards for dismissal immunity?
How do the two base gossip cards Miss Elizabeth Perkins and Miss Florence Oliver affect reputation, and can a player at 1.1 be targeted?
When does a Barn earn reputation: when hosting an Estate activity, when merely owning an Estate tile, or when passing? How much is earned?

How does the Servants’ Quarters improvement tile differ from Service Help and ordinary service rotation, how many servants can it supply per turn, and where does a servant used through it go afterward?
What are the Private Study’s front-side activity requirements, and can you host it repeatedly once upgraded to gain Village Fair income?
Compare the Main Library activity before and after upgrading: service, family count, card reward and effect of its extra objective on the final objective total.
For the Objective VP card, how many objectives are drawn and kept, where does the other go, and does this increase your final objective count?
Can a Refresh Service VP card recover servants from Expended Service and make them usable immediately, and how does that differ from Service Help?
When a Hire Servant VP card is used, what servant source and destination apply, can an underbutler be chosen, and can the hire immediately provide service?
A Refresh Guest VP card is used before choosing attendees. May it return a family member, from where, and can that card attend this activity?
At scoring, does the base basic-servant objective include a butler, housekeeper or underbutler, and how does this differ from normal service VP and the ten-servant objective?
For a monument objective and a category objective, do the upgraded Queen’s Suite and Lionheart Suite count, and how are hybrid categories counted?
What tiles can complete the base Nature Group and Domestic Group objectives, what are their VP rewards, and must the tiles have been used?
For the base prestige-guest and every-three-guests objectives, which gentry count, how does the final Fairchild count, and does an incomplete group of guests score?

What reputation condition earns the base reputation objective, what wealth condition earns its wealth objective, and does reputation wheel position change ordinary reputation VP or reputation tie resolution?
Compare the base West Terrace before and after upgrading: service, required attendees, favours and whether it becomes an ongoing dismissal tile.
Is there a maximum number of gentry cards allowed in your hand or personal discard pile, and do gentry in the discard pile still belong to you?
The Reserve contains several stacked tiles. May you inspect all of them and buy any one, or must you buy the top tile? What information is public?
Must you host an activity whenever you could legally host one, and what are your options if your preferred activity lacks the required gentry or servants?

Can a player who passes refresh the Market with the free passing benefit, also pay for the Refresh Market special action, and also use Market Refresh VP cards in the same turn? What exactly is the once-per-turn restriction?
